notes: Clones copy you better: how you fight each martial art, how you change when you're hurt or going for the finish, how soon you use your super and finisher, and how aggressive you are. They don't swing at air unless you do, their finisher never misses, and they (and every CPU) punish you for charging up. Sparring your clone teaches it the most. Turf Wars: claiming fixed, grey unclaimed blocks, striped locked blocks, cleaner names, and blocks can only be taken 7:45 AM to 2:15 PM (New York time) on weekdays. Hoops: orange jersey and blue shorts, and the green window keeps shrinking the deeper you shoot. Cooldowns a touch longer, XP a little lower.
